anatomy: EXACTLY four legs, her and goat; hidden leg not replaced
motion_rule: SHE drives every whole-body move; GOAT opposes her — blocks, stamps, springboards
camera_moves: own move, shot size per beat below; camera always moving
character: fluffy white alpaca, yellow hard hat, long neck, buck teeth, huge goggling eyes open all clip
cast: GOAT foreman, blue hard hat, tape, notepad, stamp, whistle — antagonist, wrestles her most beats, no lines
props: chrome trolley, wire basket, squeaking wheels; belt of overstuffed dolls filling frame
hero_doll: one rag doll overstuffed to bursting, riding the belt, stuffing bursting from a split belly, cracked mouth flaps when squeezed
environment: toy factory, glass roof, belt filling frame; tags, stuffing, torn price tags drift past lens all clip
lighting: blazing noon sun through glass roof, hard chrome highlights

light_events.event: the lever throws a white spark, strobing her face and the goat's silhouette

audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.1 syllables/sec, never hurried
audio.voices: 0.7, 4.3, 8.5 are the alpaca; 6.0 is the doll — a tinny flat wind-up toy voice
audio.pacing: each line is one unbroken phrase in its own beat; voiceless in every other
audio.lip_sync: her mouth works every syllable of her lines; doll's line: her mouth shut, doll's flaps
audio.sfx: conveyor rumble all clip, tape snap 0.0, page flip 0.7, stamp thud 2.9, whistle 3.6, lever clang+spark 6.6, doll-pile crash 7.3, hoof scrabble 8.0

timeline.a: goat crouches measuring her trolley; she rears and poses for his tape like a model while a hind hoof shoves the trolley out of his reach; camera push in low
she trots backwards down the aisle, slinging a doll across her withers like a scarf; goat scribbles in his notepad, trotting after her; camera slow orbit
she rams the trolley under the goat's raised hoof; his stamp slams an unmarked print into its side; camera whip-pan on hit
she snatches the stamp from his hoof in her teeth and prints it on his blue hard hat; camera handheld arc
goat blows whistle, splays all four legs blocking aisle; she crouches, haunches coiling to launch; camera low push in
she springs off goat's back as a springboard, snatches the overstuffed doll off the moving belt with her teeth mid-air, hoists it overhead; camera cranes with leap
she shakes the doll in her jaws with her whole body, stuffing bursting from its torn belly into the lens as it squeaks; camera macro push
she flings doll into the wire basket, it wedges in the grate; goat yanks the belt lever down, a spark flashes; camera whip-pans basket to lever
dolls heap up against her stalled trolley; she keeps raking them in with both hooves until the whole heap avalanches over her; camera overhead top-down
she bursts head-first out of the heap and, instead of climbing free, snatches one more doll off the pile with her teeth; camera low tracking
pinned under the dolls, she braces all four legs, bursts chest up out of the pile, one hoof still clutching a doll by its leg, no goat in frame; camera push low-to-high

must_appear: her driving every beat incl 8.5-10.0 bursting from the pile, the goat opposing her, the doll taken off the moving belt, basket heaped by 7.3
negative_prompt: cyrillic, readable text, subtitles, watermark, letters on stamp, night, dusk, dark scene, human hands, second alpaca, fifth leg, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, malformed hooves, slow motion, static camera, alpaca standing still, stopped conveyor belt, accented Russian
